reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully covers supplier onboarding and proposal management.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents an independent outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Supplier registers, submits proposals, and receives feedback; no other HLG covers this end-to-end process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches administrative evaluation and automation.

decisions.rationale: This is a subset of inventory management (hlg_5092a5cab66a3b3d_001) with overlapping responsibilities.
decisions.outcome_justification: Evaluating proposals is part of broader operational efficiency, not an independent outcome.
decisions.covered_by_high_level_goal_name: Support accurate and timely product inventory management

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects inventory tracking and replenishment.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and covers a distinct operational outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Inventory management includes real-time tracking, reordering, and manual overrides; no other HLG addresses this holistically.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches goods receiving and store placement.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents a distinct workflow outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Goods receiving involves verification, location assignment, and defect reporting; no other HLG covers this step.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction conflates order fulfillment with proposal evaluation.

decisions.rationale: The parent mixes two distinct outcomes (order processing and proposal management).
decisions.outcome_justification: Order fulfillment should focus solely on processing, payments, and partial deliveries.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Separate order fulfillment from proposal evaluation; retain payment and delivery handling.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully covers online shopping and payment.

decisions.outcome_justification: Online purchasing includes browsing, checkout, tracking, and notifications; no other HLG addresses this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches ticket lifecycle and agent performance.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents a distinct support outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer support involves ticket management, response tracking, and reassignment; no other HLG covers this.

decisions.rationale: The parent lacks specificity about data analysis for business decisions.
decisions.outcome_justification: Data collection should focus on enabling management insights, not just reporting.
